name: forge-relay
description: Multi-agent coordination board for Claude Code and Codex CLI - live claims, event feed, and STOP commands via MCP. Companion to Forge LLM.

commands.title: Forge Relay: Get Started (configure agents + verify)
Forge Relay: Toggle Clanker Mode (worker write/edit/run)

forgeRelay.port.description: Port for the Forge Relay MCP server. Both Claude Code and Codex CLI connect here.

forgeRelay.claimTtlMinutes.description: How long a file claim stays active before it expires automatically.

forgeRelay.coordinationPath.description: Absolute path to the repo being coordinated. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.

forgeRelay.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js binary used to run the runtime bridges. Leave empty to use 'node' from PATH.

forgeRelay.claudePermissionMode.description: Permission mode for the headless Claude (Mode B) runtime bridge. 'acceptEdits' lets it act on the board without prompts; 'bypassPermissions' is fully unattended but less safe.

forgeRelay.claudeModel.description: Optional model override for the headless Claude (Mode B) runtime bridge. Leave empty to use your Claude Code default.

forgeRelay.claudeKeepAliveMs.description: Cache keep-alive interval (ms) for the headless Claude (Mode B) bridge. When > 0, the bridge sends an inert no-op turn after this much board idle to keep the prompt cache warm across the ~5-minute TTL. 0 disables it (rely on natural activity). For an A/B test set this just under the TTL, e.g. 240000 (4 min).

forgeRelay.claudeKeepAliveMaxPings.description: Max consecutive keep-alive pings the Claude (Mode B) bridge sends while the board is idle before it pauses. Each real board event resets the count, re-arming the warm window. This caps idle cost: without it the bridge pings forever (e.g. ~$1.40 over a 4-hour idle tail). 0 = unbounded (the old runaway behavior — not recommended).

forgeRelay.subagentBridgeUrl.description: Optional generic OpenAI-compatible base URL for the 'bridge:' route of dispatch_subagent. Empty (default) = route off. The legacy Forge Python bridge this used to point at (http://127.0.0.1:9099/v1) was removed from Forge in the 2026-06 refactor; prefer 'forge:' routing via subagentForgeControlUrl.

forgeRelay.subagentOllamaUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the Ollama backend used by dispatch_subagent (prefix a model with 'ollama:').

forgeRelay.subagentDirectUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the direct llama.cpp llama-server backend (prefix a model with 'direct:').

forgeRelay.subagentBridgeApiKey.description: API key for the bridge backend, if it requires one.

enumDescriptions: Blocks until the worker finishes and returns its result inline - best for quick tasks; folds the worker output into the orchestrator's context.
Fires the worker in the background and returns immediately; the worker posts progress/result to the board and @mentions the orchestrator when done - best for parallel fan-out (e.g. the 8-worker run).
forgeRelay.subagentDefaultMode.description: Default run mode for dispatch_subagent when the orchestrator does not specify `mode`. The orchestrator can still override per-call. Set to 'async' to make parallel background dispatch the default.

forgeRelay.subagentDefaultBackend.description: Which backend an unprefixed dispatch_subagent model id targets (when the Forge route is off).

forgeRelay.subagentForgeControlUrl.description: Opt-in Forge model-control API base (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8799). When set, dispatch_subagent routes unprefixed (and 'forge:'-prefixed) models through Forge, which loads the requested model on demand, waits until it is healthy, and returns its endpoint - eliminating 'fetch failed' / wrong-model errors. Leave empty to keep the direct bridge/ollama/direct routing.

forgeRelay.ollamaAutoStart.description: Opt-in: when a dispatch routes to the ollama backend and the daemon is down, start 'ollama serve' once and re-probe (bounded). Off by default - explicit over hidden. Forge's control server is never auto-started from Relay (it runs in the VS Code extension host).

forgeRelay.codexExecutable.description: Codex CLI executable for the 'codex' worker backend of dispatch_subagent (default: 'codex' on PATH). Dispatch with model "codex" or "codex:<model>" to run a task via codex exec, sandboxed by board autonomy (draft = read-only, clanker = workspace-write).

forgeRelay.codexWorkerTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock cap (ms) for one codex exec worker run dispatched via dispatch_subagent; the process is killed past it. Default 15 minutes.

forgeRelay.ollamaExecutable.description: Executable used for ollama auto-start (default: 'ollama' on PATH). Only used when forgeRelay.ollamaAutoStart is enabled.

forgeRelay.defaultAutonomy.description: Initial worker autonomy. 'draft' = workers are read-only and propose diffs (safe). 'clanker' = workers may write/edit/run directly, bounded by the destructive-command denylist. Toggle live with the board pill or the Toggle Clanker Mode command.
